This means the source sheet never actually states the break's real duration - it only marks that a break exists after Period 4, without giving it explicit minutes. Classes 9 & 10 table has no such issue (fully consistent, already matches current seed).
period_timing_ambiguity.recommendation: Period 4 should be treated as a REAL teaching period at its listed time (confirmed via the actual per-class grid, e.g. 1A's Period 4 = Games every weekday). Confirm real break duration with school.
